emily: started onboarding brook-mini-v1 (FP->int6) to staging. quick recall@1 on short-snippets holdout down ~0.025 vs prod fp32. posting run + quick notes — anyone around?
rafa: paste command + numbers pls.
emily: command i ran:
```
./tools/embed_eval.py --model brook-mini-v1 --quant int6 --dataset short-snippets --index hnsw --ef 150 --norm unit
```
summary:
```
baseline fp32: recall@1=0.914
this int6 run: recall@1=0.889  # -0.025
recall@5: 0.964 -> 0.951
```
chez: hmm. first checks: 1) quant-mode (per-tensor/per-channel)? 2) quant backend (our-runtime vs onnx)? 3) was batch-norm folded or any model surgery?
emily: default build used runtime-int6 per-tensor. no planned surgery. i did notice the file that ships with the model has a small stored "whiten" transform on disk, but our eval wrapper also applied --norm unit. possible double-normalization.
rafa: also ef=150 maybe borderline. try ef=300 and force per-channel quant. run with --norm none if relying on stored transform.
eval-bot: regression-detected: recall@1 delta=-0.025 vs baseline on dataset=short-snippets. severity=medium. ticket=ML-6001
emily: re-ran with per-channel + ef=300 + norm none:
```
./tools/embed_eval.py --model brook-mini-v1 --quant int6 --quant-mode per-channel --dataset short-snippets --index hnsw --ef 300 --norm none --export=pairwise_delta.csv
```
new results:
```
recall@1=0.909
recall@5=0.959
median pairwise delta=0.019 (prev 0.062)
```
jin: ok that smells like per-tensor quant + normalization mismatch. pairwise delta cut indicates relative geometry preserved with per-channel. next steps: 1) update model-catalog default for brook-mini-v1 -> int6 per-channel, 2) add onboarding smoke that runs short-snippets with ef=300 and fails if recall@1 < fp32 - 0.02, 3) include pairwise_delta.csv and a tiny UMAP snapshot in artifacts for triage.
rafa: agree. also add a quick layer-scale sanity log to model build artifacts so we can catch accidental per-tensor fallbacks during packaging.
emily: i'll open PRs for the catalog change + CI smoke and kick off a 10-seed stability sweep. attaching results to ticket ML-6001 when done. thanks! :rocket:
